         ARSENICUM BROMATUM

       Bromide of Arsenic


Has proven a great anti-psoric and anti-syphilitic remedy. Herpetic
      eruptions, syphilitic excrescences, glandular tumors and indurations, carcinoma, locomotor
      ataxia, and obstinate intermittents, and   diabetes   are all
      greatly influenced by this preparation.



Face.--    Acne rosacea  , with
      violet papules on nose; worse in the spring.   Acne   in young
      people.



Dose.--  Tincture, two to four drops daily in water. In diabetes,
      three drops three times a day in a glass of water.
